name: Cinematic FPV
summary: One continuous flight through a place: a small drone with an ultra-wide camera dives, banks and threads gaps at 15 to 35 m/s. The camera moves like a bird, and the cut hides inside a wipe.

philosophy.core_thesis: A camera that can go anywhere should not cut: one unbroken flight turns space itself into the story.
design_principles: Fly one continuous shot of 20 to 60 s and hide each cut in a wipe: pass behind a pillar, a tree or a wall at 0 to 2 frames of black.
Shoot at 4K 60 fps with a 180° shutter (1/120 s) and conform to 24 or 30 fps for a slow-motion drift of 40% to 50% speed in the slow parts.
Use an ultra-wide lens of 150° to 170° field of view (about 14mm equivalent) and hold a subject at 3 to 10 m from the lens for scale.
Fly at 15 to 35 m/s on a dive and at 3 to 8 m/s for a reveal, and keep the camera uptilt at 25° to 45°.
Fit an ND filter of ND8 to ND16 in daylight so that the shutter stays at 180°.
Shoot in a flat log profile and grade with one LUT at a gain of 60% to 80%, saturation +10%.
Match each speed change to the music on a beat of 90 to 130 bpm and mix at −14 LUFS.
anti_patterns: A cut every 2 s on a rapid-fire montage
A slow, high-altitude orbit at 5 m/s
A shaky, unstabilised shot with a rolling-shutter wobble
A shutter faster than 1/500 s that makes the flight look stuttered
A flat, eye-level pan with no change of altitude
A flight that ignores the subject and only shows the sky
A clip with the on-screen display left in

composition.framing: A wide 16:9 or 2.39:1 crop; the subject or the gap fills 15% to 30% of the frame, and the horizon tilts with the bank.
composition.staging_in_depth: A layered path: foreground obstacle at 1 to 3 m, subject at 5 to 20 m and the open space beyond.
composition.subject_placement: On a third line; the path leads from the bottom corner to the subject on a curve.

principles.rule: Fly along a line in the scene, such as a ridge, a stair or a rail, and let it lead the eye through the shot.
Pass an object in the foreground to give a 3-plane parallax: near, mid and far.
principles.value: 3 planes, near pass at 0.5 to 2 m

principles.rule: Fly through an opening that is only a little wider than the drone to show size by tension.
principles.value: gap 1.2 to 2 times the drone width

principles.rule: Hold one fast flight line of 15 to 40 s with one cut, and avoid cutting inside the dive.
Aim the nose at the target and keep it on the third line as the camera dives.
principles.value: target at 33% or 67% of the frame height

camera_and_movement.movement: A single flight line with dives, banks, flips and gap threads; the speed changes by 3 to 5 times along the path.
camera_and_movement.support: 5-inch or 3-inch FPV drone with an action camera or a cinema camera
camera_and_movement.camera_height: 0.5 to 50 m, changing along the path
camera_and_movement.move_speed: Dive 25 to 35 m/s; cruise 15 m/s; reveal 3 to 8 m/s

lens_and_format.aspect_ratio: 16:9 (3840 × 2160 px); crop to 2.39:1 for a cinema piece
lens_and_format.frame_rate: 60 fps capture, conform to 24 or 30 fps
lens_and_format.focal_length: Ultra-wide, about 14mm (35mm format), 150° to 170° field of view
lens_and_format.aperture: f/2.5 to f/2.8 with ND8 to ND16
lens_and_format.resolution: 4K at 60 fps, 10-bit where the camera allows
lens_and_format.focus: Fixed, deep focus from 1 m to infinity; no focus pulls in flight.
equipment: action camera or compact cinema camera

light.quality: Natural light at golden hour or in soft overcast; a hard noon sun is allowed when a shadow gives scale.
light.direction: Side or back light on the subject, so that edges and spray glow; keep the sun out of the lens by 30° or more.

colour_and_grade.treatment: A clean log-to-LUT grade. Saturation and contrast are up a little, so that sky and speed read at once.
grade_recipe: Set the base to the flat log profile and add a conversion LUT at 70% strength.
Set the black point at 3% and the white point at 98%.
Add an S-curve of +20% contrast and a highlight roll-off from 85%.
Raise saturation by +10% and pull the sky to hue 215°, a little deeper.
Add motion-matched sharpening at 10% and no grain.

editing_and_rhythm.average_shot_length: 20 to 60 s for a one-take; 6 to 12 s in a sequence of linked flights
editing_and_rhythm.cutting_logic: Cut only on a wipe: match the object that fills the frame, and join the flights by that object and by the beat of the music.
editing_and_rhythm.transitions: Object wipe of 0 to 2 frames, speed ramp of 0.5 to 1 s, match on a flip or a dive.

sound.approach: Music leads. The prop and wind noise of the drone mix in at −20 to −26 dB under the score for a feel of speed.
sound.dialogue: None, or a short voice-over of 1 to 2 lines.
sound.music: A driving electronic or cinematic score at 90 to 130 bpm; each speed ramp lands on a beat.

titles_and_graphics.treatment: None in the flight. A lower-third place name or a title card of 1.5 to 2 s at the end.
titles_and_graphics.type: Light, wide-tracked sans-serif, white, at 4% of frame height.

shot_primer.opening: Open on a fast move toward a gap or a drop in the first 2 s; no hold on a static frame.

canonical_works.work: Red Bull FPV drone at the Las Vegas Grand Prix

emotion.target_response: Exhilaration and weightlessness: the viewer flies through a space no camera could reach.

use_cases: music video with a one-take flight
video prompts for a drone fly-through
avoid_when: The brief needs a still, formal frame or a face at close range.
The site is indoors with people and no flight permission or safety plan.

modifiers.how: Replace the flight with a handheld follow at 1.2 m/s and keep the single long take of 20 to 60 s.
Keep the dive; cut the flight to 15 to 30 s in 9:16 and add a caption hook in the first 2 s.

aspect_ratio.note: The 16:9 frame maps to 1.85:1, the nearest option of the domain.

frame_rate.note: Capture at 60 fps and conform to 24 or 30 fps.

sources.title: Porsche Newsroom: Drive 2 Extremes, Taycan Cross Turismo with Johnny FPV (2021)
DroneDJ: FPV dive the Burj Khalifa (2021 report on the 2020 video)
